description: Sent every five seconds with the position of the roof vents.

message_id.description: Identifies the message. See Table 5-1 and Table 6-1.

message_length.description: Length of the message in 16-bit words.

sequence_number.description: Incremented by the sender for each message; wraps from 1023 to 0.

time_of_day.description: Milliseconds since local midnight when the message was built.

roof_vent_offset_sign.description: Angle of the roof vents from the commanded angle, sign-magnitude: bit 15 is the sign (1 is negative), bits 14-6 the magnitude.
roof_vent_offset_sign.note: Sign-magnitude in the document: the value is roof_vent_offset_magnitude, negative when roof_vent_offset_sign is Negative.

roof_vent_offset_magnitude.description: Angle of the roof vents from the commanded angle, sign-magnitude: bit 15 is the sign (1 is negative), bits 14-6 the magnitude.
roof_vent_offset_magnitude.note: Sign-magnitude in the document: the value is roof_vent_offset_magnitude, negative when roof_vent_offset_sign is Negative.

motor_current.description: Current drawn by the vent drive motor.
